verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents letting the customer's own system authorize transactions instead of Pomelo's authorizer, via a customer authorization endpoint. That covers the approve-each-authorization half of just-in-time funding, but nothing shows a choice of funding models or explains how money moves. missing for 10: documented prefunded-balance funding model, explicit just-in-time funding flow (how authorized amounts are funded and settled), an option to choose between funding models, documented cash-flow tradeoffs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can choose how transactions are funded — prefunded balances or just-in-time funding where my system approves and funds each authorization — with the cash-flow tradeoffs documented

citations.quote: Autorizar y ajustar transacciones sin usar nuestro Core de crédito o Autorizador.
Un endpoint de autorización configurado con nuestro equipo de integradores.
